lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba4Mg2 (reduced formula Ba2Mg) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ba centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Ba, 6 Mg) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg centers have 10 neighbors (8 Ba, 2 Mg). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that 10-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra exhibit corner, edge, and face sharing, while Ba–Ba 12-vertex polyhedra share corners and edges.
